scripts.prepare:db: bun install --cwd ../contracts --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ../contracts build && bun install --cwd ../db --force --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ../db build && bun install --force --frozen-lockfile
scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --conditions=supacloud-source --external @supacloud/compiler && bun run build:tool-runtime && bun run build:types
scripts.build:tool-runtime: bun build src/tool-runtime.ts --outdir dist --target node --external typebox && tsc -p tsconfig.tool-runtime.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.pretypecheck: bun install --cwd ../delivery --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd ../compiler --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd ../compiler build && bun run prepare:db
